_comment: Free models only. The engine's premise is that every query costs nothing —
the revenue is the Kickbacks.ai ad share, not a margin on inference — so a
billed endpoint here would not be an upgrade, it would be a loss.
A 'paid_models' block used to sit here listing openrouter/openai/gpt-4o and
anthropic/claude-3-sonnet-20240229. Nothing in the repo ever read it, so it
was dead config, but it was also the one place a paid slug could be picked
up by someone wiring in a new caller. Removed on 2026-08-14 so 'total free'
is true by construction rather than by nobody having referenced it yet.
The live race list is FREE_MODELS in proxy/arbitrage.py, not this file.
